title: Sirius XM favorites and station list behavior
summary: Feedback centers on Sirius XM playback working normally in some cases, while many other comments describe favorites setup, favorites-list navigation, and channel-list display without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say Sirius XM and FM radio play normally without issues.

negative.summary: The only clearly negative review mentions possible Sirius XM involvement in an issue but does not describe a confirmed favorites or playback fault.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews discuss how to set presets, favorites not staying saved, the system leaving the favorites list, and requests to show the full Sirius XM channel list instead of only favorites, but several fragments are too incomplete to classify confidently.

limitations: Most sample fragments are undetermined or incomplete, limiting confident interpretation of whether comments reflect defects, feature requests, or usage questions.
Some examples mix unrelated Sirius XM topics such as playback status, favorites management, head-up display channel browsing, and comparison to other vehicles rather than one single coherent issue.
